discovery.note: Antigravity discovers GEMINI.md / AGENTS.md only, walking up from cwd to the repo root. It never reads .antigravity.md, which is where TangleClaw wrote this file until 2026-08-31. AGENTS.md is a multi-vendor convention and is frequently owned by another writer, so this profile merges a managed block rather than owning the file.

busyMarker.source: #560 live spike, Medusa builder pane: the status row flips from `? for shortcuts` to `esc to cancel` while a spinner shows 'Generating…'.

promptPattern.source: #560 live spike: the bare `>` input line is STILL rendered mid-turn on this engine, which is why the pattern alone cannot gate a nudge here and `idleMarker` is required alongside it.

promptGlyph.source: #560 live spike: `>` is the composer glyph.

promptPad.source: Never captured from a live pane. `null` keeps the older, laxer composer reading rather than inheriting Claude Code's measured NBSP — an unmeasured engine gets the honest laxer gate, never a borrowed fact (#1109).

placeholderSgr.source: Live captures of both engines (#1105): antigravity greys its mode banner ('Accept-edits mode: …') with SGR 90 (bright black) rather than dimming it — a different attribute for the same idea, which is why this is declared per engine and not shared.

idleMarker.source: #560 live spike: `? for shortcuts` is present at rest and absent during both generation and any dialog/menu. Required here because the bare prompt persists mid-turn, so the busy marker is never the only thing between a nudge and a busy pane; it also makes the permission-dialog case fail-safe by construction, since a dialog drops the hint.

pasteRejectedMarker.source: agy 1.1.22, sessions 899/900/901 (#1134): the CLI's own words when it discards a submission during account verification — the complete at-rest UI rendered while the account was still verifying and everything submitted was dropped. NOT re-confirmed on 1.1.24, whose verify window could not be reproduced here (this account is already verified), so the marker may be a no-op on newer builds. Safe in the direction that matters: an absent marker leaves the pre-existing verdict untouched and never invents a retry.
